reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that converts image message blocks into text placeholders and uses a local Qwen-based script with DashScope to provide image descriptions to text-only models; human review is warranted because installation requires upstream package patches and external API credentials.

summaries.zh: 为仅支持文本的 DeepSeek Harness 模型将图片消息转换为包含本地路径的文本占位，并通过视觉脚本生成图片描述。
summaries.en: Bridges image messages to text-only DeepSeek Harness models by replacing image blocks with local-path placeholders and obtaining descriptions through a vision script.

capabilities: Rewrites image message blocks into text placeholders containing local attachment paths
Invokes a local vision script to describe images
Sends image content to the DashScope vision API through the provided script
Requires configuration of an external API key
Requires patches to official DeepSeek Harness packages to permit image messages
